claude.sample_unit: patient educational materials from ACPA-approved craniofacial team websites

links.outcome: Reading grade level of existing cleft lip and palate patient educational materials
links.effect: Flesch-Kincaid Grade Level showed texts written at a median 9th-grade reading level, above the recommended 6th-grade level.
links.quote: Initial evaluations using the Flesch-Kincaid Grade Level formula showed that the texts were written at a median 9th-grade reading level.

links.outcome: Readability and clarity of patient education materials before and after ChatGPT-4 simplification
links.effect: ChatGPT-4 modification significantly improved readability from median 9th-grade to median 6th-grade level with enhanced clarity.
links.quote: Modifications using ChatGPT-4 significantly improved readability, achieving a median 6th-grade level and enhanced clarity.

unlisted_practices: Incorporating interactive educational content (videos, photos, case examples, audio clips) into patient education materials
